declared_deviations: Modern stack instead of Python 3.6 / CUDA 10.2 PyTorch: vendor edits E1-E4 (VENDOR.json); G-port (gport/a4/gport.json) shows bitwise-equal forward, losses, gradients, two Adam steps and the cosine LR schedule vs the unmodified official code on CPU.

PHYRE engine: upstream phyre d0765dd built from source (b127-phyre recipe) instead of the copy bundled in DynamicsAware; the C++ engine sources and the Box2D tree are identical except the self-supervised-only get_random_images option and the pybind11 bytes bindings; 100k cache sha256 14c516c1... (1000 cached actions re-simulated without mismatch by A1).

One RTX 5090 instead of the authors' hardware: run_sweep_file.py submits with --n-gpu 4 by default (DataParallel over 4 GPUs, so BatchNorm statistics per 128-sample shard) [INFERENCE: the paper does not state the GPU count]; here one GPU, BatchNorm over the full 512-sample batch. cuDNN kernels are not bitwise deterministic.
The official code never seeds torch (random initialisation per run) and uses RandomState(42) for batch sampling; kept as is.

paper.citation: Ahmed, Bakhtin, van der Maaten, Girdhar. Physical Reasoning Using Dynamics-Aware Models. arXiv 2102.10336v2 (ICML Workshop 2021)
paper.quote_caption: Table 1: AUCCESS of dynamics-aware DQNs compared to state-of-the-art models on the PHYRE-1B and 2B tiers in the within-template and cross-template generalization settings. Results reported are averaged over 10 test folds.
paper.spread_statistic: standard deviation of the per-fold AUCCESS over the 10 test folds (population SD, numpy.std ddof=0)
paper.spread_statistic_source: The paper prints '±1.1' without naming the statistic. The official repo's summary for exactly this run (agents/experiments/hand_crafted_experiments/06_hand_crafted_test_run_table_1.conf, 'fmt EVALSETUP->MEAN±STD') is agents/run_sweep_file.py, which replaces STD with np.std over the per-fold results.json scores (seed = fold id, folds 0-9). PHYRE (Bakhtin et al. 2019) reports its DQN row the same way (77.6±1.1).

repairs: at most two logged repair attempts, each fixing a diagnosed port defect, never this band (P-fid); otherwise A4 is dropped with fidelity_not_reproduced
rule: G-fid Tier T passes iff the mean AUCCESS x 100 over folds 0, 1, 2 (one training run per fold, test split, trained on train + dev) lies in [85.0 - 2 x 1.1, 85.0 + 2 x 1.1] = [82.8, 87.2]. +-2 SD of single folds is wider than +-2 SE of a three-fold mean (2 x 1.1 / sqrt 3 = 1.27); the per-fold SD also covers the systematic difference between the folds 0-2 mean and the 10-fold mean.
